title: Deep sequential branching (mock)
goal: Mock dataset (not empirical or user data). Follow twelve taxa in a deeply nested ladder while retaining the order of divergence.

rubric.must: Lineages 01 and 02 are sisters; each successive lineage joins the previous group through 12.
All twelve labels are visible without merging into one text block.
The deep sequence of slanted branches can be followed without confusing crossings.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the phylo/slanted exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows twelve distinct labels, Lineage 01 through Lineage 12, in divergence order. Lineages 01 and 02 are sisters at the deepest visible split; each later lineage branches from the accumulating group. The slanted ladder branches are traceable without crossings or material overlap.

items.evidence: Lineages 01 and 02 share the topmost split; Lineage 03 joins their group, then each successive lineage through Lineage 12 joins the preceding group.
All twelve labels, Lineage 01 through Lineage 12, are visible separately in the taxon column.
The deep slanted branches form a continuous ladder with no confusing crossings; dashed guides connect tips to their corresponding labels.
